questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property changes the text color?
questions.explanation: The 'color' property sets the text color in CSS. There is no 'text-color' property.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: How do you write a comment in CSS?
questions.explanation: CSS uses /* */ for comments. // is JavaScript, <!-- --> is HTML, # is Python/shell.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which selector targets an element with id='hero'?
questions.explanation: # targets IDs, . targets classes, plain names target tags.
